title: Why Does the Missing Gravity Follow the Baryons? The Reconstruction Difference as a Third Interpretation Beyond Dark Matter and MOND
content: The difference between the gravitational acceleration inferred from observed galactic dynamics, gobs, and the acceleration reconstructed from visible baryonic matter, gbar, is commonly interpreted either as evidence for an additional dark-matter component or as a manifestation of modified dynamics characterized by the MOND acceleration scale a0. This paper develops a third origin category centered on the gravitational reconstruction difference Δgrec = gobs − gbar. The subtraction itself is elementary. The proposed novelty is its embedding in a reconstruction and response architecture. The visible baryonic record is interpreted as a restricted and generally non-invertible local representation of a richer background structure that may be gravitationally relevant. A reduced observable record need not reconstruct the underlying structure completely, while selected relational properties of that structure may remain physically effective within the record. The Born map and the Aharonov-Bohm effect provide the structural precedent. Born probabilities are neutral to a common global phase, whereas relative phase and holonomy remain observable through interference. Readout reduction therefore does not imply loss of all relational influence. The current approach transfers this architecture conditionally to galactic dynamics: the continuing local influence of background structure not fully represented in the baryonic record is encoded by a baryon-coupled response potential Φresp, with Φeff = Φbar + Φresp and Δgrec = −∇Φresp. This origin interpretation is organized through a hierarchy that separates the existence of the discrepancy, its acceleration-dependent amplitude law, and its spatial organization. Within that hierarchy, MOND describes the amplitude law, dark matter supplies a candidate cause, and halo profiles describe spatial organization.   A possible cosmological normalization is summarized by Λ → aΛ → χ → a0 → Φresp → Δgrec. The structural precedent does not derive gravity from quantum mechanics, and no dynamical arrow in this chain is yet derived. The proposal becomes a distinct gravitational theory only if a covariant response operator and discriminating predictions can be obtained.
